verdict.rationale: Sandbox or test environments are a fair question for an agent-hosting platform, but the evidence never documents a sandbox, test mode, or staging environment kept apart from production data. Scoped API keys, per-agent VMs and a free plan are adjacent controls, not a separate test environment. The Swagger UI explicitly runs requests against the real API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
